data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to implement a Material Design Speed Dial with labels and animated icons.
data.what_it_does: Renders a Material Design Speed Dial widget that can be placed in Scaffold.floatingActionButton. It supports labels, animated icons, multi-directional children, and automatic closing on back button press or overlay taps.
use_when: You need a floating action button that expands into multiple action choices
You want to display a Material Design speed dial with custom labels and animations
avoid_when: You are implementing standard navigation bars or tabs
You require a non-Material custom menu layout
strengths: Supports custom labels, active children, and animated icons
Handles closing automatically on back button press
Allows spacing and padding configuration between children
weaknesses: Limited to Material Design speed dial paradigms
May require manual state management via ValueNotifier for external open/close control
data.minimal_example:
SpeedDial(
  icon: Icons.menu,
  activeIcon: Icons.close,
  children: [
    SpeedDialChild(
      child: const Icon(Icons.accessibility),
      label: 'First',
      onTap: () => {},
    ),
  ],
)
